text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 20, "unit": "marbles", "kind": "count", "span": "20 marbles"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 50, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "had 50"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "2/5"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "2/5"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 2, "unit": "kgs", "kind": "count", "span": "2kgs"}], "plan": [{"op": "div", "args": ["q3", "q4"], "out": "s1", "note": "fraction 2/5 as a decimal multiplier"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s1", "q1"], "out": "s2", "note": "marbles father gave = 2/5 times the 20 Solomon bought from Johanna"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s3", "note": "marbles in store after Solomon added the 20 he bought to the 50 already there"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s3", "s2"], "out": "s4", "note": "total marbles in the store including the ones from his father"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s4", "q5"], "out": "s5", "note": "total weight = total marbles times 2kgs per marble"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the total weight, in kilograms, of all the marbles Solomon has in the store"}, "dismissed": []}
